Application Data.NAME: Stitched Designs Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Stitched Designs Co. specializes in high-quality custom embroidery and apparel production, offering personalized designs for businesses, organizations, and individuals. Our operations include machine embroidery, screen printing, and heat transfer applications, all performed in-house to maintain quality control. We also have a retail storefront where customers can view samples and place orders directly. We prioritize the use of locally sourced materials to ensure compliance with labor standards and mitigate supply chain risks. Our commitment to safety includes regular maintenance of equipment and installation of fire prevention systems to reduce operational hazards.
